Master your PCS to Fort Cavazos by unlocking the real truth about what your 2026 BAH can buy in Killeen Texas and the surrounding Central Texas area! In this packed guide, Stephan Harris—aka Real Estate Steph—dives deep into the Texas housing market, breaking down your actual buying power using the latest BAH rates. You’ll discover four home affordability categories, complete with real-life examples of what’s available in Texas, plus, Steph highlights the best (and worst!) neighborhoods, comprehensive school district ratings, and the major pros and cons of new construction versus resale homes. This video is your essential roadmap for military families searching for the perfect place to live near Fort Cavazos. Learn how to leverage your VA loan for maximum value, avoid common buyer mistakes, and get insider tips no one else shares. Steph covers not only real estate options, but also the true cost of living in central Texas, things to do in the Killeen area, and expert strategies for navigating the fast-moving Texas housing market. Whether you’re new to the area or already stationed near Fort Cavazos, this guide ensures your next move is a smart one. Don’t let your BAH go to waste—find out where you can get the most house for your money! Share your questions or experiences in the comments for a chance to get featured in the next video. Your dream home—and big savings—might be just one click away.
